hypothesis: A known decline in the monthly seasonally adjusted job openings rate over three observation-months adds monotone information about a later two-month unemployment rise beyond frequency alone.
model: sigmoid(logit(b)+beta*x); b=(past_target_events+1)/(past_target_cases+2); x=clip((JTSJOR(latest-3months)-JTSJOR(latest))/0.5,-3,3); beta>=0 minimizes SUM historical Bernoulli negative log likelihood + beta^2/2, offset logit(b) fixed.
training_clock: historical-origin frozen claims features and base UNRATE; labels initially available by current cut only
acceptance: at least5percent lower paired Brier than BOTH frequency baselines and strictly lower than persistence; exploratory screen only, never automatic prospective admission
missing_policy: exclude from all compared scores; no imputation, no nonconsecutive weeks, no revised-current-history substitution
retuning: None. New demand-side observable after prior failed candidates; adaptive inspected history, not confirmatory. No lag/scale/penalty/subset search.
solver: Derivative monotone; beta=0 if derivative at zero>=0; otherwise double upper bound from1 until derivative>=0 and run100 bisections.
reporting: All eligible paired months including pandemic; annual descriptive only; retain exclusions and compare only within each sample. No selecting years.
jolts_source: ALFRED JTSJOR, Rate, Monthly, Seasonally Adjusted; full real-time interval ZIP hash pinned privately before calculation; observation coverage2011Jan–2026Aug.
jolts_requirement: At each historical cut25, latest available nonmissing JTSJOR must equal target-3months, separately from UNRATE base target-2months. Require latest and latest-3months rates from audited daily intervals; omit on missing, older or newer latest reference. Decimal rates0..100; no integer-thousands assumption.
